name: glasser
description: Research companies, markets and the web inside ChatGPT. Glasser connects ChatGPT to live data on companies and prospects, search rankings and keywords, websites and online reviews, social profiles, local businesses, news and property records. Ask things like "What industry is example.com in and how many employees does it have?" or "Compare search visibility for example.com and a competitor", and ChatGPT finds a suitable data endpoint, shows what it needs, and runs it once you approve. Built for sales, marketing and research teams that need answers grounded in returned data.

interface.longDescription: Research companies, markets and the web inside ChatGPT. defaultPrompt: Find the industry, employee count and headquarters of example.com.
Compare organic search traffic and top keywords for example.com and a competitor in the US.
Summarize what users say about an app in its recent App Store reviews.

positive.description: Company intelligence before a sales call: headcount and growth, funding and tech stack.
positive.prompt: Use Glasser to get Notion's (notion.com) current employee count, its headcount change over the last 12 months, its latest funding round with the lead investors, and the main technologies detected on its website.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports Notion's employee count and one-year headcount growth, latest funding round with investors, and main tech-stack tools from the returned data, labels estimates and says what is missing.

positive.description: SEO competitive data: organic traffic, ranking keywords, referring domains and a keyword gap.
positive.prompt: Use Glasser to compare notion.com, coda.io and clickup.com in the US on estimated monthly organic traffic, number of ranking keywords and referring domains. Then list 5 keywords where coda.io ranks in the top 10 and notion.com does not, with their monthly search volume.
positive.expected_behavior: Compares the three domains on estimated US organic traffic, ranking keywords and referring domains, and lists five keywords where coda.io ranks in the top 10 and notion.com does not, with monthly search volume.

positive.description: Prospect list: companies matching firmographic filters with a hiring signal.
positive.prompt: Use Glasser to find 10 B2B SaaS companies in Germany with 50 to 200 employees that have open sales job postings right now. For each, show the company name, website, employee count and one open sales role.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to 10 German B2B SaaS companies with 50 to 200 employees and open sales roles, with name, website, employee count and one open sales role each.

positive.description: App Store review analysis; the run is asynchronous.
positive.prompt: Use Glasser to pull the 100 most recent US App Store reviews of the Duolingo app, then give me the three most common complaints and the three most praised features, each with a short quote.
positive.expected_behavior: Gets the reviews with runs_get while the run is still working, then lists three common complaints and three praised features, each with a short quote from the returned reviews.

positive.description: US property value and rent with comparable rentals.
positive.prompt: Use Glasser to get the estimated market value and estimated monthly rent for 2100 Guadalupe St, Austin, TX 78705, plus three comparable rentals nearby with their monthly rents.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the property's estimated value and rent estimate and three comparable nearby rentals with their monthly rents, labelled as estimates.

negative.description: The user supplies the text, so ChatGPT rewrites it directly without Glasser.
negative.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph to sound clearer and shorter: Our team has been working very hard over the past several months in order to make sure that the new version of the product is able to meet all of the needs that our customers have told us about, and we are very excited to finally be able to share it with everyone.

negative.description: A writing task that needs no external data; ChatGPT drafts the email directly without calling Glasser, even though a company is named.
negative.prompt: Draft a short cold email to Stripe's head of sales introducing our analytics product.

negative.description: General knowledge; ChatGPT answers directly without calling Glasser, even though the topic is SEO.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between SEO and SEM.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold in ChatGPT. Users sign in to an existing Glasser account with OAuth; no checkout, subscription or upgrade flow appears in the plugin.

publication.release_notes: First submission of Glasser: one skill and the Glasser MCP server (search endpoints, inspect their inputs and Price, run with the user's authorization, get run results).
